description: Adversarial held-out routing cases: shared terms with different meanings, misleading workflow keywords, near-identical project names, history-based reopening and new topics. Labels were written before the first run and the router prompt was not changed afterwards. null means no registered project clearly owns the request; such a request should be left for the operator rather than confidently assigned.
